title: Composer Repository Fetch Workflow
activity_flow: START: loadPackages() called with packageNameMap + stability params
CHECK: rootData already set? → RETURN cached rootData
CHECK: openssl extension loaded for HTTPS? → THROW RuntimeException if missing
IF cache hit AND rootMaxAge set AND cache age <= maxAge → use cachedData directly
ELSE IF cache hit AND last-modified header present → fetchFileIfLastModified(url, key, lastModified)
IF no data yet → fetchFile(getPackagesJsonUrl(), 'packages.json', null, storeLastModifiedTime=true)
VERIFY sha256 hash of response body (if sha256 provided)
IF hash mismatch AND retries left → sleep 100ms, retry (up to 3 times)
IF hash mismatch AND no retries → THROW RepositorySecurityException
IF other Exception AND cache fallback exists → use degraded cache, set degradedMode=true
IF storeLastModifiedTime AND last-modified header → embed in data
PARSE root data: extract notify-batch/notify, search, mirrors
IF metadata-url (V2 protocol) → set lazyProvidersUrl = metadata-url, clear providersUrl, hasProviders=false
IF available-packages → build availablePackages map, hasAvailablePackageList=true
IF allowSslDowngrade → downgrade https to http in URLs
IF no providers AND partial package missing → skip
IF partial package exists for name → use partialPackagesByName data directly
ELSE IF providerListing null → loadRootServerFile() + loadProviderListings(data)
DETERMINE URL and cacheKey based on lazyProvidersUrl or providersUrl
CHECK cache: sha256 match (static) OR last-modified check (lazy)
IF cache valid → use cached packages
On 404/499 for lazy providers → treat as empty packages []
SKIP if wrong name or already loaded
CHECK isVersionAcceptable(null, name, version, stabilities, flags)
IF AliasPackage → also set repo on aliasOf package
INCLUDE AliasPackage aliases of matched packages
BRANCH B: lazyProvidersUrl set AND remaining packageNameMap not empty (V2 async path)
IF hasAvailablePackageList → filter packageNameMap to only known packages
IF dev stability acceptable → also queue 'name~dev' variant
IF ONLY dev stability requested → remove non-dev entry
CHECK packagesNotFoundCache → resolve with empty immediately
CHECK freshMetadataUrls → resolve with true (304 simulation)
ON 200 → cache response, resolve with data
ON 404 → cache as not-found, resolve with empty
IN .then(): if response==true → use cached contents, else use fresh response
CALL loop->wait(promises) — block until ALL async downloads complete
CHECK isVersionAcceptable(constraint, name, version, stabilities, flags)
IF AliasPackage → also register aliasOf package in result map
MERGE async result packages into main packages array
key_conditions: rootData cached → skip full loadRootServerFile fetch
metadata-url present → V2 protocol path (async, no providers)
hasAvailablePackageList → filter unknown packages before async load
dev-only stability → skip non-~dev metadata file
sha256 mismatch → retry up to 3 times, then RepositorySecurityException
TransportException 404 on lazy fetch → treat as empty (not error)
degraded mode → fall back to stale cache with IO warning
AliasPackage → register both alias and aliasOf in result
key_relationships: ComposerRepository depends_on HttpDownloader (sync get + async get)
ComposerRepository depends_on MetadataMinifier (expand minified V2 data)
ComposerRepository creates AliasPackage (sets repository on alias + aliasOf)
loadAsyncPackages uses ReactPHP loop->wait() for concurrency
important_notes: V2 protocol (metadata-url) uses async HTTP (ReactPHP promises + loop->wait). V1 protocol uses synchronous fetchFile. Stability filtering happens at two levels: per-package-name (whether to even fetch ~dev variant) and per-version (isVersionAcceptable). AliasPackage entries always carry their underlying package with them. Cache keys use 'provider-vendor~name.json' pattern. fetchFile retries 3 times on hash mismatch or network error.
